## Step 2: Investigation  
### Category 1: Failed Transactions  
**Investigation Steps:**
1. Pull transaction record from system
2. Check status (why did it fail?)
3. Verify customer authorization
4. Confirm account details correct
5. Assess if reversible  
**Common Failure Reasons & Resolution:**  
| Reason | Investigation | Resolution |
|--------|---|---|
| Insufficient funds | Confirm balance at time of attempt | Explain to customer, offer retry once funds available |
| Invalid recipient | Check account number format | Contact customer for correct details, retry |
| Account frozen | Confirm freeze in place and reason | Unfreeze if valid, notify customer |
| Duplicate prevention | Check for earlier same transaction | Explain duplicate rule, offer manual retry |  
**Outcome:** Refund if funds were debited + failed, retry if appropriate, or explain to customer

raw_entities.name: Failed Transaction Investigation Process
raw_entities.description: An operational procedure for investigating and resolving failed transactions on customer accounts. The process involves pulling transaction records, determining failure reasons, verifying customer authorization and account details, assessing reversibility, and determining appropriate resolution actions including refunds, retries, or customer explanation.
context: Outcome: Refund if funds were debited + failed, retry if appropriate, or explain to customer

raw_entities.name: Transaction Record Retrieval
raw_entities.description: The initial step of pulling the transaction record from the system to begin investigation of a failed transaction.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Status Check
raw_entities.description: Examination of the transaction status to determine the reason for failure.

raw_entities.name: Customer Authorization Verification
raw_entities.description: Verification that the customer authorized the failed transaction.

raw_entities.name: Account Details Confirmation
raw_entities.description: Confirmation that the account details provided in the transaction are correct.

raw_entities.name: Reversibility Assessment
raw_entities.description: Assessment of whether the failed transaction can be reversed or refunded.

raw_entities.name: Balance Confirmation at Transaction Attempt
raw_entities.description: Confirmation of the customer's account balance at the time of the failed transaction attempt to verify insufficient funds as the failure reason.
context: Confirm balance at time of attempt

raw_entities.name: Recipient Account Number Validation
raw_entities.description: Verification of the recipient account number format to identify if invalid recipient details caused the transaction failure.

raw_entities.name: Account Freeze Status Confirmation
raw_entities.description: Confirmation of whether an account freeze is in place and the reason for the freeze when account frozen is identified as the failure reason.
context: Confirm freeze in place and reason

raw_entities.name: Duplicate Transaction Check
raw_entities.description: Verification of whether an earlier identical transaction exists to determine if duplicate prevention rules caused the transaction failure.

raw_entities.name: Customer Notification and Resolution
raw_entities.description: Communication to the customer explaining the failure reason and offering appropriate resolution such as retry, refund, or explanation of policy.
context: Explain to customer, offer retry once funds available
Contact customer for correct details, retry
Explain duplicate rule, offer manual retry

raw_entities.name: Transaction Failure Reason Determination
raw_entities.description: A branching decision point that categorizes the transaction failure into one of five common reasons: insufficient funds, invalid recipient, account frozen, duplicate prevention, or other. Each reason path leads to specific investigation and resolution steps.

raw_entities.name: Insufficient Funds Failure Path
raw_entities.description: Decision path triggered when insufficient funds is identified as the transaction failure reason, leading to balance confirmation and customer explanation with retry offer.
context: Insufficient funds | Confirm balance at time of attempt | Explain to customer, offer retry once funds available

raw_entities.name: Invalid Recipient Failure Path
raw_entities.description: Decision path triggered when invalid recipient details are identified as the transaction failure reason, leading to account number format verification and customer contact for correction.
context: Invalid recipient | Check account number format | Contact customer for correct details, retry

raw_entities.name: Account Frozen Failure Path
raw_entities.description: Decision path triggered when an account freeze is identified as the transaction failure reason, leading to freeze confirmation and conditional unfreezing with customer notification.
context: Account frozen | Confirm freeze in place and reason | Unfreeze if valid, notify customer

raw_entities.name: Duplicate Prevention Failure Path
raw_entities.description: Decision path triggered when duplicate prevention rules are identified as the transaction failure reason, leading to earlier transaction verification and customer explanation with manual retry offer.
context: Duplicate prevention | Check for earlier same transaction | Explain duplicate rule, offer manual retry

raw_entities.name: Transaction Investigation Investigator
raw_entities.description: The operations staff member responsible for executing the failed transaction investigation steps, including pulling records, verifying details, assessing reversibility, and determining appropriate resolution.

raw_entities.name: Account Freeze Authority
raw_entities.description: The role responsible for unfreezing an account when the freeze is determined to be valid and the transaction failure is resolved.

raw_entities.name: Failed Transaction
raw_entities.description: A financial transaction that did not complete successfully on a customer account, requiring investigation to determine the failure reason and appropriate resolution including potential refund or retry.
context: Outcome: Refund if funds were debited + failed, retry if appropriate, or explain to customer

raw_entities.name: Customer Account
raw_entities.description: A customer account subject to transaction processing and potential failure scenarios requiring investigation and resolution.
context: Account frozen | Confirm freeze in place and reason

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: The account holder whose transaction has failed and who requires notification and resolution of the failure.
context: Explain to customer, offer retry once funds available
Contact customer for correct details, retry
